description: This Java source file defines the 'LoanScheduleParams' class, which encapsulates parameters and state related to loan schedule calculations in a microfinance or lending application. It manages various financial quantities such as principal, interest, fees, and associated date mappings, supporting partial and complete updates for loan data processing.

classes.name: LoanScheduleParams
classes.description: Immutable class capturing the parameters and state used during loan schedule calculations, supporting creation via multiple static factory methods for different update scenarios, and providing methods for managing schedule-related data.

methods.name: createLoanScheduleParamsForPartialUpdate
methods.description: Creates an instance for partial updates with given parameters, indicating that only part of the loan schedule data is being modified.

methods.name: createLoanScheduleParamsForCompleteUpdate
methods.description: Creates an instance for complete update scenarios, resetting the schedule state.

methods.name: createLoanScheduleParams
methods.description: Initializes schedule parameters using disbursement charges, scheduled start date, principal amount, and context.

methods.name: createLoanScheduleParams
methods.description: Creates a schedule parameter object based on an existing loan schedule, for adjustments.
